conclusion.saved_takeaway: The oracle objective sums each example's minimum member loss. Each minibatch forwards all members and backpropagates an example only through its minimum-loss member. Expertise emerges from winner-take-gradient training; top-k winner variants interpolate toward ordinary ensembles.
